E0803

`triple` is Scale, not a function

What

`triple` is Scale, not a function

Why

Parentheses call functions and lambdas only

Fix

Call one of the value's methods, such as `triple.apply(4)`, or write a method that returns a lambda.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0803: tests/ui/call_non_function.stderr.

Error [jet.CalledNonFunction]: This is Int (a whole number), not a function
  --> tests/ui/call_non_function.jet:4:13
    |
  4 |     result: get_number().call(1)
    |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Only a function value can be called with `.call(…)`
 Fix: Call a defined `fn` by name, or store a lambda in a binding before `.call(…)`
